_meta.description: Human verdicts for cases string matching cannot decide, for the 100-case / 30-document evaluation (runs of 2026-10-22). Each overrides the automatic outcome for that condition and case. Every answer in review_needed.csv was read, plus PII-08 and PII-12 (obfuscation) in every condition. Verdicts for the earlier 71-case runs are retired with those runs.
